scout.flavor: You use your new knowledge to improve yourself as a scout. You are now an actually useful scout!

rogue.text: Get 1 extra turn at the beginning of combat.
rogue.flavor: You realized that no matter how strong you get, there are always stronger foes. Instead, you learn to use your quick wits to take the upper hand in combat. You are now a rogue!

ranger.flavor: You learn to embrace your inner cowardice and triumph over your enemies from distance. You are now a ranger!

fighter.flavor: You focus your mind on the intricate movements and strategies of combat. You are now a fighter!

warrior.flavor: You train yourself to ignore pain and focus on taking down the enemy. You are now a warrior!

cutthroat.text: Start with 2 extra turns at the beginning of combat.
cutthroat.flavor: After all those near death experiences, you begin to look for quicker, dirtier ways to take down the enemy. You are now a cutthroat!

hunter.flavor: You've become proficient in taking down dangerous monsters. With your expertise in combat and knowledge of behaviors, you survive in any hostile environment. You are now a hunter!

forester.flavor: Your new knowledge allows you to improve your perception of the surroundings. You are now a forester!

apprentice.flavor: You have learned the secrets of spellcasting. You are able to practice the gathering and focusing of mana to manipulate the physical world. You are now an apprentice!
